title: ko-key-mismatch: engine and solver disagree on when a ko exists

diagnosis.root_cause: koAfterCapture in src/gtp.zig set a ko point whenever exactly one stone was captured (opp_before - opp_after == 1). The solver (src/exp6_solve.zig apply_place/apply_place32/apply_place4) additionally requires the capturer to be in atari with no friendly neighbours (liberties == 1 and friendly == 0).
diagnosis.impact: The engine produced lookup keys with ko values the solver never assigned, causing lookup misses in the oracle artifact. The engine fell back to area-score fabrication, the Bellman comparison failed (UNCHAINABLE refusal), and the history-free greedy fallback produced nonsensical moves — including filling its own two-point eye in game 1.
diagnosis.family: Third defect of this family: T178 (exp6 rank vs colex), T193 (passes bit encoded as 0), T265 (ko field). Every one is a lookup key built differently by producer and consumer.
diagnosis.second_game_explained: The second game produced misses at ko=0 and ko=16 (KO_NONE) that appeared to escape the ko-rule diagnosis. In fact: the ko=0 states are ko-inconsistent (no capturer in atari — same root cause), and the ko=16 state is downstream of earlier off-manifold play. A single wrong ko determination puts the game off-manifold; every later lookup misses regardless of its own ko field.
diagnosis.cited_states_all_inconsistent: Every cited state (colex=26668645 ko=3, colex=29301769 ko=12, colex=29355009 ko=3/12, colex=2456372 ko=0, colex=5798208 ko=16) checked against solver's ko rule — all non-KO_NONE states have ko points the solver would never assign. Random sample confirms: ~2.4% of single-stone captures under the old rule disagree with the solver.

fix.change: Added played_cell detection and the solver's ko rule: count liberties and friendly neighbours of the capturer in the post-capture position; only set ko if liberties == 1 AND friendly == 0.
fix.commit: 626ec55 (committed by Orcha while T265 console was running)
fix.verified_by: Orchestrator — replayed human game transcripts through fixed binary: game 1 misses 14→0, UNCHAINABLE refusals 2→0; game 2 misses 12→0, refusals 2→0. All 20 engine moves now from the table.

tests: ko key (T265): old engine rule disagrees with solver (negative control)
ko key (T265): fixed engine rule agrees with solver
differential_test.result: Old rule: disagreements found on all sizes (confirmed bug). New rule: 0 disagreements all sizes (confirmed fix).

verdict: CONFIRMED and FIXED. koAfterCapture aligned to solver rule. Differential invariant registered — the third such guard after T178 and T193. Human game replays confirm misses dropped to 0.
